name: The Job Board
hours: An alcove in the arcade by the campus store, always accessible; new slips go up Monday mornings.
sight: A deep alcove tiled in blue and white with a cork wall three metres wide, bristling with slips of coloured paper: yellow for campus jobs, green for town, red for urgent. Tear-off tabs flutter in the draught. Beside it hang the official glass cases: exam schedules, event rosters, results. A pencil on a string has been chewed by a decade of students doing sums.
things: Take a job slip (see the jobs list) and report to whoever posted it
Read the event rosters and results in the glass cases
Find the handwritten 'will tutor for credits' and 'will trade tutoring for cards' notes
Read the red slips — the urgent, the odd, the oddly specific
Work out on the back of a slip how many shifts make 9,000 credits
Post a notice of your own
secret: Entry point of the job system and the place rosters are posted: the Freshman Cup roster with LEGAL NAMES goes up on the morning of Day 19, here and on the arena doors — 'Kaboom, Inya' — and the crowd around the glass case is how Rowan learns it if Inya has not told him herself. Livvie checks the board before breakfast every Monday; her arithmetic is on the back of half the slips. Red slips worth noticing: 'Lost: one cat, grey, answers to Mulligan — last seen Commons beach' (Day 28; animals are fleeing the Commons); 'Field assistants wanted, north slope survey, 40 cr/slot, discretion required' (Day 62; Marrow's crater camp, signed by Santángel).
